summary: Phase B Mobile-First UX & Geo-Pre-filling testing complete. All 3 Sell forms (CreateListingPage, CreateMultiItemListing, CreateVehicleListingPage) have proper mobile responsive CSS classes. Testing verified: vertical field stacking, 48px min-height buttons, inputMode='decimal' for price fields, responsive stepper indicators with overflow handling, and full-width nav buttons on mobile. Desktop regression passed - forms display correctly in 2-column layout.
